fields.zone: The physical area or department of the facility.
fields.role: The job title or classification of the person.
fields.authorization: Whether access or action is permitted.
fields.station: The specific equipment or workstation identifier.
fields.rule: The full text of the operational or safety rule.
fields.subject: The entity or station that the rule applies to.
fields.sensor: The type of sensor or measurement being monitored.
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the sensor value.
fields.nominal: The target or normal operating value and its tolerance.
fields.critical_response: The required action when a critical threshold is breached.
fields.action: The required corrective or maintenance action.
fields.station_id: The unique identifier for the station.
fields.depends_on: The station or system that this record depends upon.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of a fault on subsequent stations or processes.
fields.trigger: The specific condition or event that initiates a rule or alarm.
fields.priority: The importance or urgency level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of people allowed in the zone.
fields.enforcement: The rules governing how limits are enforced or monitored.
fields.anomaly_type: The classification of the detected anomaly.
fields.definition: The technical description of what constitutes the anomaly.
fields.detection_criterion: The logic or mathematical formula used to detect the anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal system classification of the event.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning alarm.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm.
fields.requirement: The mandatory compliance or logging requirement.
fields.pattern: The causal chain or sequence of events.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause or main failure identified.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting symptoms or side effects of the primary fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to resolve the issue.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger stating when a rule applies.
fields.station_dependencies: The overall flow or dependency map of stations.
fields.primary_criterion: The main objective or standard being measured.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The logical ordering of threshold levels.
fields.cafeteria: The identifier for the cafeteria station.

categories.AccessAuthorization: Rules regarding who is allowed in a zone.
categories.SensorThreshold: Limits and bounds for sensor readings.
categories.OccupancyLimit: Limits on the number of people in a zone.
categories.AcknowledgmentTime: Time limits for responding to alarms.
categories.FaultResolutionProcedure: Steps to fix a detected fault.
categories.FaultPropagationRule: How faults move through the system.
categories.VerificationProcedure: Steps to verify a state or fix.
categories.EscalationProcedure: Steps for increasing the urgency of a response.
